newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian CA board said to have resigned.
newsitem.headline: Austrian CA board said to have resigned.

text.p: The board of Austrian flagship bank Creditanstalt-Bankverein (CA), which was taken over by Bank Austria in January, is believed to have resigned, a board member said on Friday.
"I offered my resignation to Creditanstalt's supervisory board and to Gerhard Randa (chief executive of Bank Austria) after the decision (on January 12)," Max Kothbauer told reporters.
"I assume all the other members also resigned," he added.

Kothbauer said he had sent a written resignation to Creditanstalt's supervisory board last week after the European Union approved the sale of the state's 70 percent stake in the bank for 17.2 billion schillings to Bank Austria.
Chairman of the board Guido Schmidt-Chiari is expected to resign, but there has been no official confirmation that any board members apart from Kothbauer has stepped down.
